description: Shows the user the cruises you are recommending, as cards with ship photo, route, dates, price and booking link -- drawn by the host, not by you. Call it ONCE, as the LAST step of your answer, with the cruise_id values of a previous find_cruises result that you recommend (3-5, in your recommended order). Never call it before you have decided what to recommend, and never more than once per answer. It does NOT search; an unknown or expired cruise_id is left out and named in the result -- call find_cruises again if that happens.

cruise_ids.description: cruise_id values from a previous find_cruises result, 3-5, in your recommended order.

handle.description: Consultation handle returned by a previous call (structuredContent.handle). Pass it on every call so wishes are remembered; omit it on the very first call.

language.description: Language of the answer. Defaults to the provider's language.

name: show_offers
title: Show recommended cruises
